site.intro: An editorial-grade recruiting and storytelling hub celebrating the people behind the mission.

hero.title: People of NASA
hero.subtitle: Rebuilt as a flexible publishing platform so your team can launch a richer, more modern version of the original page without touching code unless you want to.

mission.title: What We Do
mission.bodyHtml:
NASA employees shape missions that expand what humanity knows and what future explorers can achieve. This version of the page is designed to help your team publish those stories with more visual range, faster updates, and better editorial control.

You can swap photography, rewrite messaging, update calls to action, and restructure sections directly in the admin panel.

callouts.title: Modular storytelling
callouts.text: Each homepage block is editable independently for campaigns and seasonal refreshes.

callouts.title: Recruitment ready
callouts.text: Built-in CTA surfaces help point visitors toward applications, profiles, and internal priorities.

callouts.title: Fast publishing
callouts.text: WYSIWYG editing and direct JSON editing support both editors and developers.

gallery.title: Faces of NASA
gallery.intro: A flexible mosaic for profiles, teams, interns, leadership, and campaign spotlights.

culture.title: Life at NASA
culture.bodyHtml:
Use this section to highlight mentorship, collaborative programs, internships, benefits, and what daily work feels like across the agency.

The layout pairs a strong visual with bullet benefits so it can function as a culture pitch, recruiting block, or employer-brand module.
benefits: Purpose-driven work tied to real missions
Flexible content blocks for benefits and recruiting
Optimized for both desktop and mobile storytelling

explore.title: Turn a static page into an evolving editorial system.
explore.text: This upgraded section can anchor seasonal campaigns, events, STEM outreach, or hiring pushes. It supports richer copy, stronger imagery, and more intentional calls to action.

cards.title: Play Starship Game
cards.description: Take a break with a Flappy Bird-style Starship mini-game and chase a new high score.

cards.title: Employee Spotlights
cards.description: Meet Audrey Montgomery in the featured spotlight and connect visitors with pathways into NASA careers.

cards.title: Impact & Innovation
cards.description: Understand the mission-critical foundation that guides NASA's most important decisions.

cards.title: Get Involved
cards.description: Drive visitors into recruitment pipelines, events, and programs.

footer.title: Ready for your next version
footer.text: This starter gives you a publishable front end plus a practical admin system you can extend with authentication, workflows, and approvals.
